newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KNP BT upbeat on distribution, packaging.
newsitem.headline: KNP BT upbeat on distribution, packaging.

text.p: Paper, packaging and office products group KNP BT said on Thursday prospects were good for both its distribution and packaging units in the second half.
"KNP BT distribution is expected to again post good results in the second half," the company said in a statement.
Based on well-filled order books, performance at its Graphic Systems unit was set to improve, KNP BT added.
It said the outlook for its packaging division was also good, as a previously-announced rise in corrugated cardboard prices started to work through into results.
However profits at KNP Leykam, its paper unit, were expected to remain under pressure in the second half, it added.
